note: Frozen check list for unslop evals 1-6. Written before any run of these evals and not to be edited to fit an output. Its author had read no output of the skill: the smoke test notes (unslop-workspace/smoke-2026-11-21/README.md) were opened only as far as their method, and the trigger transcripts of 2026-11-21 hold no edited text. Each assertion in evals.json is decomposed into atomic yes/no checks. kind=file and kind=absence are decided by a script from the bytes on disk after the run; in an eval with no fixture the only file is the reply, and check 1.2 and check 2.14 are decided on it. kind=reply, kind=invention and kind=negative are decided by an LLM judge. A met kind=reply check quotes the words or the file:line that satisfy it. kind=invention and kind=negative are negatives: when met there is nothing to quote and the evidence is the search; when unmet the offending words are quoted. In evals 1, 4, 5 and 6 the text is pasted and the edited version comes back inside the reply, next to the reply's own notes, where a removed phrase is often quoted: a script cannot tell the two apart, so the checks on the edited text there are judged and say so. In evals 2 and 3 the edited text is a file and the same kind of check is a script check. A fact the text must keep is one check per fact. A borderline case resolves to not met. More text never raises a verdict.
